s1.syndrome_frame: Acute to subacute onset of unilateral lower limb pain and weakness with associated systemic symptoms
salient_findings: Increasing left leg pain and weakness
Bilateral iliacus and iliopsoas muscle oedema with enhancement on MRI
key_facts: One week of increasing left leg pain and weakness
Anorexia and 12% body-weight loss over six months
Low blood pressure responsive to IV fluids
4/5 strength in left hip and knee flexors and extensors on neurologic examination
Mild foraminal narrowing at L5–S1 on lumbar spine MRI
No central canal stenosis or abscess on lumbar spine MRI
Small anterior joint effusion on left hip ultrasound
Bilateral iliacus and iliopsoas muscle oedema with enhancement on MRI of the hips and pelvis

shortlist.label: Psoas abscess
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated inflammatory markers and muscle oedema with enhancement on MRI

shortlist.label: Iliopsoas bursitis
shortlist.why_kept: Small anterior joint effusion on left hip ultrasound and muscle oedema on MRI

shortlist.label: Septic arthritis of the hip
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated inflammatory markers and joint effusion, despite normal hip MRI

shortlist.label: Idiopathic inflammatory psoas muscle disease
shortlist.why_kept: Bilateral iliacus and iliopsoas muscle oedema with enhancement on MRI

shortlist.label: Polymyalgia rheumatica
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated inflammatory markers, anorexia, and weight loss in an elderly patient

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation of increasing left leg pain and weakness, impaired mobility, and elevated inflammatory markers, combined with the MRI findings of bilateral iliacus and iliopsoas muscle oedema with enhancement, are most consistent with idiopathic inflammatory psoas muscle disease. The absence of evidence for infection or malignancy also supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Psoas abscess
rejected.why: No evidence of abscess on MRI of the lumbar spine or hips and pelvis

rejected.label: Iliopsoas bursitis
rejected.why: No evidence of bursitis on MRI of the hips and pelvis

rejected.label: Septic arthritis of the hip
rejected.why: Normal MRI of the hip and no evidence of infection on joint aspiration attempts

rejected.label: Polymyalgia rheumatica
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms and laboratory results are more localized to the psoas muscle and do not meet the typical criteria for polymyalgia rheumatica
